action.description: Lifecycle verb. 'create' issues a new schedule; 'update' mutates the named task; 'delete' tears it down; 'list' enumerates the operator's tasks; 'run-now' triggers an off-schedule invocation.

task.description: Required for create/update/run-now. Names are operator-scoped and must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,63}$.

schedule.description: ISO-8601 duration ('PT15M', 'P1D'), RFC-5545 RRULE, or 5-field cron expression. Runner normalizes to UTC and rejects schedules under 1 minute.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for schedule interpretation (e.g. 'America/New_York'). Defaults to UTC.

target_capability.description: Mesh capability id to invoke when the schedule fires (e.g. 'analytics.sql-query', 'coding.run-tests'). Runner validates that the active lease template covers the target's required scopes.

target_inputs.description: JSON payload passed to the target capability. Validated against the target's input schema at create time; invalid payloads are rejected before persistence.

task_id.description: Stable mesh-assigned id, distinct from the human-readable name.

next_run_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the next scheduled invocation, when applicable.

summary: Manage mesh-internal scheduled tasks that invoke other capabilities on cron or RRULE schedules. Create/update/delete trip human approval; list is free.
notes: Schedules under 60 seconds are rejected to prevent runaway loops. A scheduled task that targets a capability requiring approval will still pause for approval on each fire — the schedule does not bypass downstream gates.
